Pixel-perfect Webflow → Next.js port for 2 routes in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq.

Routes to fix:
1. /how-it-works  →  src/app/how-it-works/page.tsx + src/components/how-it-works/*
2. /beta  →  src/app/beta/page.tsx + src/components/beta/*

GOAL: Match `https://boldteq.com/how-it-works` and `https://boldteq.com/beta` 100%. Webflow source: `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/how-it-works.html` and `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/beta.html`. Production-grade.

WORKFLOW PER PAGE:
A. Read Webflow source HTML
B. Read local page.tsx + all components in matching folder
C. Identify section render order, missing sections, extra sections, CSS divergence
D. For each Webflow class, grep `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` for ALL rules at every breakpoint
E. Edit local CSS modules to match verbatim
F. Replace inline `style={{}}` with module classes
G. Add SEO Metadata API tags
H. All images: next/image with proper width/height/sizes/alt
I. `pnpm build` 0 errors

WEBFLOW MEDIA QUERY MAP:
- Default
- @media (min-width: 1280px)  (line 21619)
- @media (min-width: 1440px)  (line 23146)
- @media (max-width: 991px)   (line 24454)
- @media (max-width: 767px)   (line 26907)
- @media (max-width: 479px)   (line 29202)

HOW-IT-WORKS-SPECIFIC NOTES (per CLAUDE.md):
- Hero with 4 stat badges + GuideJar embed
- Agency Fit: 3-column (Your Agency / Boldteq / Your Client)
- 3-step process with screenshots
- 4-step detailed workflow
- "Designed to Remove Risk" section: 4 cards (White-Label, Dedicated Team, Turnaround, QA)

BETA-SPECIFIC NOTES (per CLAUDE.md):
- Different pricing from main site: Beta Lite $299/mo, Beta Pro $599/mo
- Bug report card + Add-on hours card
- "How it works" 3-step section
- "Who It's Built For" 3-segment section
- CTA: "Your Execution Team. Live in 12 Hours."

CONSTRAINTS:
- TypeScript strict, no `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `console.log`
- Next.js 16 App Router patterns
- Mobile-first, all 5 breakpoints
- Stack A — no Vercel/Stripe/Prisma

OUTPUT: 1-line summary per page + build result.
